item.title: Average Net Worth of Retirees
item.description: U.S. households reported an average income of $141,390 and an average net worth of $1.06 million in the 2022 U.S. Federal Reserve Survey of Consumer Finances. The average man in America retired at age 65. The average woman retired at age 63. item.title: How to Calculate How Much Money You Need to Retire: Financial Independence Retire Early
item.description: There are several ways to calculate how much money you need to retire.
